draft.weaknessQuote: Very modest ball production for his level of traits and talent.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.46, the 15th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 2nd of 37 at CB. He went 8th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jimmy Smith. Testing standouts: vertical jump (94th percentile), broad jump (91st percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2020, 12th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers (reserve). 53 career games and 53 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 5 (98th percentile), approximate value 9 (96th percentile), completion % allowed 48.4% (95th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 27.5% (1st percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 90.3% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
